title: Two Wild Geodude keep mutual Cargo claims until one normal pickup

verification.actor: Two current Wild Geodude on Route29 with a passive Cyndaquil follower.
verification.trigger: Place Player at586406 and Wild Geodude at584402 and588402. Let normal Player notices and Cargo queries run with neutral input.
verification.observable: Geodude A claims B during an accepted Walk. B then gets a fresh reachable query to A; both exact unheld claims stay live until one physically picks the other. One full HELD owner persists through a normal Cargo Hop launch. No claim, timer, profile, motion or control is injected.

setupMutations.change: Checked teleport Player586406; prepare native party0 Cyndaquil155Lv20 and Follower; spawn Wild Geodude74Lv20 A at584402 and B at588402. Observe 180 neutral-input completed frames. No claim, timer, profile, motion or control is written.

limits: Prepared placement does not prove natural population selection.
Both actors are Wild; this case does not prove Follower ownership.
Stops after normal Cargo launch; landing and damage are outside this claim.

events.value: Both current Geodude receive normal Player notices on the four-tile row.
A claims B, then B has a fresh reachable query and both unheld outgoing claims stay live.
One Geodude physically picks the other; the loser claim clears, one HELD owner persists, and the Cargo launches normally.

stop.condition: Same-pair normal Cargo launch or first failed current owner, claim, field or motion observation.

invariants: Both full Wild actor handles and native source identity stay current.
A normal accepted Walk claim precedes a fresh B-to-A reachable query.
Both outgoing unheld claims stay live until the first physical pickup.
The loser claim clears at pickup; exactly one HELD owner persists.
The same full Cargo launches by a normal Hop.
